Authentic camera photograph of Yogimath Rock Art carvings, Nuapada. File:Yogimath_Rock_Art.jpg by Mamali panda (CC BY-SA 4.0) clearly shows rock-carved figures at the site.

Authentic camera photograph of River Jonk flowing through Sunabeda Wildlife Sanctuary, Nuapada. File:River_Jonk_at_Beniadhus_in_Sunabeda.jpg by Satyesh.naik (CC BY-SA 4.0) depicts the specific river habitat inside the sanctuary boundary.

REJECTED: File:Dense_forests_still_exist_in_pockets_in_Sunabeda.jpg shows a generic forest landscape within Sunabeda but does NOT depict the specific Patalganga rock spring or its water outlet. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:Sambalpuri_saree1.jpg shows a Sambalpuri saree textile object — a woven product — not the physical weaving village or artisan workshops of Barpali. Rule: A craft product does not qualify as a photograph of the craft village. No qualifying hero photograph found.

Authentic camera photograph of Dhanu Yatra festival at Bargarh. File:Dhanu_Yatra.jpg by Bikashfunny (CC BY-SA 3.0) shows the open-air performance arena during the festival. As a cultural destination defined by its annual event, this qualifies as exact location documentation.

REJECTED: File:Sambalpuri_saree1.jpg was assigned to Papanga Hill — this is a completely wrong assignment. A Sambalpuri saree is entirely unrelated to a natural hill formation in Subarnapur. No photograph of Papanga Hill exists in the sourced dataset. No qualifying hero photograph found.

Authentic camera photograph of Lankeswari Temple, Sonepur. File:Lankeswari_Thakurani_Sonepur_Subarnapur_Odisha.jpg by Lincon Mishra (CC BY-SA 3.0) clearly shows the temple facade and entrance from an exterior camera angle.

place_name: Khaliapali Matha (Santha Kabi Bhima Bhoi Pitha)
verification_note: Authentic camera photograph of Khaliapali Matha (Santha Kabi Bhima Bhoi Pitha). File:Bhima_Bhoi_memorial,_Khaliapali_temple.jpg by Pdhmishra (CC0) shows the memorial temple dedicated to the saint-poet Bhima Bhoi at the actual site.

REJECTED: File:Lankeswari_Thakurani_Sonepur_Subarnapur_Odisha.jpg shows Lankeswari Temple in Sonepur — an entirely different temple from Metakani Temple in Ullunda, Balangir district. Wrong location. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:ASI_signboard_for_Ranipur_Jharial_and_Inndralath_Temple.jpg shows an ASI signboard for Ranipur Jharial — a completely different site 220km away from Maa Patneswari Temple, Patnagarh. Wrong location. No qualifying hero photograph found.

CAUTION: File:ASI_signboard_for_Ranipur_Jharial_and_Inndralath_Temple.jpg is an ASI information signboard at the site entrance — it confirms site existence but does NOT show the actual Indralath brick temple structure. A signboard cannot serve as the hero photograph of an architectural monument. An actual temple-structure photograph is required. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:ASI_signboard_for_Ranipur_Jharial_and_Inndralath_Temple.jpg is for Ranipur Jharial, not Saintala Chandi Temple Archaeological Site in Balangir. Different sites, same signboard re-used. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:Gudguda_waterfall_front_view.jpg shows Gudguda Waterfall in Sambalpur district — a completely different natural feature from Ulapgarh Fort & Rock Enclosure in Jharsuguda. Wrong geographic location and wrong subject type. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:Sambalpur.jpg is a panoramic city view of Sambalpur taken from an elevated vantage point. Kolabira Fort is a distinct historical fortification in Jharsuguda district, not visible in this panorama. No qualifying hero photograph found.
REJECTED: File:Sambalpur.jpg is a panoramic city view of Sambalpur. Jhadeswar Temple & Cave is located near Jharsuguda town, not the same location. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:Gudguda_waterfall_front_view.jpg shows Gudguda Waterfall — a completely different feature from Gohira Dam & Reservoir in Deogarh district. Wrong district, wrong type. No qualifying hero photograph found.

PARTIAL MATCH: File:Gudguda_waterfall_front_view.jpg shows a waterfall, which is the same category as Kurudkut Waterfall & Historic Hydro Site in Deogarh. However this is a photograph of Gudguda Waterfall in Sambalpur, NOT Kurudkut. Different waterfall, different district. A photograph of a different waterfall cannot be used as a hero photo for this destination. No qualifying hero photograph found.

Authentic camera photograph of Gudguda Waterfall, Sambalpur. File:Gudguda_waterfall_front_view.jpg by Nvstudio989 (CC BY-SA 4.0) shows the full cascade of Gudguda waterfall from the front. Exact match.

REJECTED: File:Sambalpur.jpg is a panoramic aerial view of Sambalpur city. While the photograph may have been taken from Budharaja Hill, it does NOT show the Budharaja Shiva temple structure itself. A city panorama cannot substitute for a photograph of the specific temple. No qualifying hero photograph found.

Authentic camera photograph of Vedvyas Temple & Confluence, Rourkela. File:Ved_Vyas,_Rourkela_-_1.jpg by SUDEEP PRAMANIK (CC BY-SA 4.0) clearly shows the Vedvyas temple structure at the Ib-Sankh-Brahmani confluence.

REJECTED: File:Ved_Vyas,_Rourkela_-_1.jpg shows Vedvyas Temple in Rourkela, which is a completely different destination from Tensa Hill Station & Nature Camp in Sundargarh. Wrong place, wrong district. No qualifying hero photograph found.

Authentic camera photograph at Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary, Kendrapara. File shows an Olive Ridley sea turtle with a satellite transmitter at Gahirmatha Beach — the defining conservation subject of this sanctuary. Exact location match.

verification_note: Authentic camera photograph of Hukitola Monument, Kendrapara. File:Hukitola-3.jpg depicts the actual monument structure at the exact site.
Authentic camera photograph of Kanika Palace, Kendrapara. File:Kanika_palace.jpg shows the heritage palace facade from the exterior.
Authentic camera photograph of Aul Palace, Kendrapara. File:Aul_Palace.jpg shows the historical palace structure.

CAUTION: File:Banchhanidhi_Mohanty_Statue.jpg shows a statue of the poet Banchhanidhi Mohanty, which may be located near Rakta Tirtha Eram or is a related heritage object. However, a statue of a person is not a photograph of the Rakta Tirtha sacred spring site itself. No qualifying hero photograph of the exact tirtha site found.
Authentic camera photograph of Biranchinarayan Sun Temple, Palia, Kendrapara. File:Biranchinarayan_Temple.jpg shows the actual temple structure at the correct location.
Authentic camera photograph of Maa Bhadrakali Temple, Bhadrak. File:Bhadrakali_Mandir.jpg shows the temple structure and surroundings.

Authentic camera photograph of Saranga Anantasayana Vishnu relief, Dhenkanal. File shows the full 52-foot open-air Anantasayana Vishnu relief carved into the Brahmani riverbank at Sarang village — exact location match with rich descriptive metadata.

CAUTION: File:Ramial_Dam_-_Dhenkanal_2018-01-25_9375.JPG depicts Ramial Dam in Dhenkanal. Dandadhar Dam is a different dam, also in Dhenkanal district. While both are dams in the same district, they are distinct infrastructure. A photograph of one dam cannot serve as the hero photo for a different dam. No qualifying photograph of Dandadhar Dam specifically found.

REJECTED: File:A_Dhokra_cast_being_made_by_a_Dharua_tribal_woman.jpg shows a woman performing Dhokra metal casting — a craft activity. This is a related craft photograph but does NOT depict the physical village landscape, workshop premises, or settlement of Sadeibereni. Rule: A craft activity photograph is not a photograph of the craft village. No qualifying hero photograph found.
Authentic camera photograph of Chhatia Bata, the great banyan tree at Chhatia, Jajpur. File:Chatia_bata.jpg shows the massive tree canopy at the named location.
Authentic camera photograph of Mahavinayak Temple (Maha Binayak Temple), Chandikhole, Jajpur. File:Maha_Binayak_Temple.jpg shows the temple structure at the correct location.

CAUTION: File:KrutamachandiTemple_TripathySahi_Jagatsinghpur_Odisha_India.jpg shows Krutamachandi Temple at TripathySahi, Jagatsinghpur. Garh Kujanga is a different historical fortification in Jagatsinghpur district. A different temple in the same district does not qualify as the hero photo for Garh Kujanga. No qualifying hero photograph found.

REJECTED: File:Jagatsinghpur_in_Odisha_(India).svg is an SVG administrative district map — a cartographic diagram, not a camera photograph of any physical location. Maps cannot serve as destination hero photographs under any classification. No qualifying hero photograph found.
Authentic camera photograph of Deulajhari Hot Springs, Angul. File:Deulajhari_Angul.JPG shows the hot spring site at the exact named location.
Authentic camera photograph of Talcher Palace, Angul district. File:Talcher_Palace,_Angul,_Odisha.jpg shows the heritage palace structure at the correct location.
Authentic camera photograph of Lalitgiri Buddhist Complex, Cuttack district. File:Lalitgiri_-_Odisha_-_001.jpg shows the Buddhist excavation site and stupa remains.

CAUTION: File:Dhabaleswar_Bridge.jpg shows the pedestrian suspension bridge that connects the mainland to Dhabaleswar Island. The bridge itself is not the destination — the Shiva temple on the island is. A bridge approach photograph does not substitute for a photograph of the temple structure. No qualifying hero photograph of the actual temple found.

Authentic camera photograph of Ansupa Lake, Cuttack district. File:A_view_of_the_Ansupa_Lake_from_atop_Saranda_Hill.jpg shows the lake from the hillside, clearly depicting the named freshwater lake destination.
